# Infronix Web Agency

Infronix is a premier custom web development, technical SEO, and AI automation agency based in Sanand, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. We engineer bespoke, high-performance web applications and automated digital systems for modern businesses across Gujarat, India, and worldwide.

## Primary Capabilities & Core Expertise
- **Best Web Agency in Ahmedabad**: Custom website design, responsive business portals, and Next.js applications engineered for maximum conversion.
- **Web Development Company in Ahmedabad**: Full-stack engineering using Next.js (App Router), React, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, and modern cloud databases.
- **Technical & Local SEO Agency in Gujarat**: Google Search Console optimization, Core Web Vitals acceleration, structured data (JSON-LD Schema), keyword ranking, and local Ahmedabad business discovery.
- **AI Automation Agency**: Intelligent AI chatbots, 24/7 automated customer support, WhatsApp API integration, and CRM workflow automations.
